blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Hua Siong College of Iloilo (HSCI) has cancelled classes at all levels at its main campus on Iznart Street on Thursday after what school officials described as a “reported security concern.” The precautionary suspension comes amid heightened concerns over campus security following recent deadly school shootings in Mindanao and Tacloban City. In an advisory dated Wednesday, HSCI said its main campus would be closed to students for the day to tighten security protocols, conduct a security sweep, and ensure the safety of students and personnel.
